rule: Only the developer-funded share of the bot's sales and proceeds counts as developer selling (pro-rata by funding).

evidence.summary: Polygon 10-wallet ParaSwap sell bot (cluster): 10 wallets on polygon. 34.5% of its funding came from developer wallets, so that share of its sales and proceeds counts as developer selling.
points: Ten wallets funded in the same blocks by the Settlement hub (a developer wallet): 10 x 30M v3 TEL on 2026-10-15 and 9 x 30M + 41.43M legacy on 2026-10-16.
About 1,535 ParaSwap sales of 50k-250k TEL each in one 72h window: fixed-size, high-frequency selling typical of an automated seller.

Also withdraws from KuCoin, where the Settlement hub deposited about 1.58B TEL in the same 90 days. That link is circumstantial (the exchange breaks the trail), so the KuCoin-funded share is NOT counted as developer selling.
